about_the_game:
This is a fast-paced survivor game. Players will play as martial artists with special skills, and challenge 30 levels in a 30-second violent battle. Each character has its own characteristics, and with a variety of martial arts and props, activate the power of bondage and challenge the final BOSS!

Each level is only 30 seconds, and ordinary levels quickly kill enemies to accumulate resources, and boss levels!

Multiple character martial arts characteristics

Sword Immortal, God of Wealth, Scholar... Each character has its own characteristics. Switch characters, explore completely different fighting styles, and find your destiny martial arts!

Bond martial arts system

After each level, choose randomly refreshed martial arts secrets and props, activate dozens of bond effects, and each game is a unique growth path!

Sword system + Kongtong School = Blade of Fire!

Sword system + Fist system = High attack speed + True damage = Meat shield nemesis!

The more you fight, the stronger you become, and the more you grow

Killing monsters will drop gold coins and experience, and strengthen your attack, attack speed, critical strike and other attributes in real time! The difficulty of the levels rises step by step. Can your construction defeat the final boss?

Gameplay highlights

Short, flat and fast game: 15 minutes to complete a single game, and you can complete it in a few minutes when you turn on the double speed!

Strategic depth: The martial arts fetters require delicate calculations. Is it mindless shopping? Or operating the economy? In "Wulin Wizard 2", every decision is a gamble to live and die.

—— Today, can you rewrite the limits of martial arts within 30 seconds? ——

The demo version currently provides 1 character (SwordFairy) and 1 difficulty for players to play. At the same time, about 3/4 of the props and all martial arts are released.
